text_en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered:
text_cn: 特曼人厄里法次又发言说：

text_en: “Should the wise answer with windy knowledge, and fill themselves with the east wind?
text_cn: 智者岂能以虚言作答？岂能以东风果腹？

text_en: Should they argue in unprofitable talk, or in words with which they can do no good?
text_cn: 岂能以无益的废话，无济于事的言词来辩护？

text_en: But you are doing away with the fear of God, and hindering meditation before God.
text_cn: 不但如此，而且你还废除了敬畏天主之情，断绝了在他面前的默祷。

text_en: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the tongue of the crafty.
text_cn: 其实，是你的罪恶教导你说话，叫你的口舌诡辩。

text_en: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; your own lips testify against you.
text_cn: 定你罪的，是你的口而不是我，是你的口唇作证控告你。

text_en: “Are you the firstborn of the human race? Were you brought forth before the hills?
text_cn: 你岂是第一个出生的人？在山岳未有之前，你岂已诞生？

text_en: Have you listened in the council of God? And do you limit wisdom to yourself?
text_cn: 难道你听见了天主的秘旨，把持着智慧？

text_en: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
text_cn: 有什么事，只有你知，而我们不知；只有你明了，而我们不明了？

text_en: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, those older than your father.
text_cn: 我们之中也有白头老人，年纪比你父亲还大。

text_en: Are the consolations of God too small for you, or the word that deals gently with you?
text_cn: 天主的安慰，和向你说的温和的话，你以为还太少吗？

text_en: Why does your heart carry you away, and why do your eyes flash,
text_cn: 你为何让你的感情控制着你？你的眼为何冒火，

text_en: so that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
text_cn: 竟向天主发怒，开口说出这样的话？

text_en: What are mortals, that they can be clean? Or those born of woman, that they can be righteous?
text_cn: 人算什么而敢自称洁净，妇女所生的敢自称正直？

text_en: God puts no trust even in his holy ones, and the heavens are not clean in his sight;
text_cn: 他连自己的圣者，还不信赖；在他眼中，连苍天也不纯洁，

text_en: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, one who drinks iniquity like water!
text_cn: 何况一个堕落可憎，饮恶如水的人！

text_en: “I will show you; listen to me; what I have seen I will declare—
text_cn: 我要告诉你，你且听我说；我要说明我的经验，

text_en: what sages have told, and their ancestors have not hidden,
text_cn: 即贤哲所传授，和祖先未曾隐瞒的事：——

text_en: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them.
text_cn: 这地方原只赐给了他们，尚无一个外方人从他们中间经过。 ——

text_en: The wicked writhe in pain all their days, through all the years that are laid up for the ruthless.
text_cn: 恶人一生饱受苦恼，寿数已给暴君限定；

text_en: Terrifying sounds are in their ears; in prosperity the destroyer will come upon them.
text_cn: 恐怖之声常在他耳中，平静时匪徒也来侵扰。

text_en: They despair of returning from darkness, and they are destined for the sword.
text_cn: 他不相信还能脱离黑暗，只等待遭受刀剑之害，

text_en: They wander abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it? ’ They know that a day of darkness is ready at hand;
text_cn: 注定作为鹰鸟的食物，自知大难业已临头。

text_en: distress and anguish terrify them; they prevail against them, like a king prepared for battle.
text_cn: 黑暗的日子使他恐怖，困苦艰难跟随着他，好像准备厮杀的君王。

text_en: Because they stretched out their hands against God, and bid defiance to the Almighty,
text_cn: 因为他曾伸手反抗过天主，向全能者傲慢逞强过；

text_en: running stubbornly against him with a thick-bossed shield;
text_cn: 以伸直的颈项，以坚厚的盾背攻击过天主。

text_en: because they have covered their faces with their fat, and gathered fat upon their loins,
text_cn: 他的脸盖满了脂油，他的腰积满了肥肉。

text_en: they will live in desolate cities, in houses that no one should inhabit, houses destined to become heaps of ruins;
text_cn: 他住在荒凉的城内，住在无人居留，行将化为废墟的屋中。

text_en: they will not be rich, and their wealth will not endure, nor will they strike root in the earth;
text_cn: 他不能富有，所有的财富也不能久存，也决不能向地下生根。

text_en: they will not escape from darkness; the flame will dry up their shoots, and their blossom will be swept away by the wind.
text_cn: 他脱离不了黑暗，火焰要灼干他的嫩芽，暴风要吹去他的花朵。

text_en: Let them not trust in emptiness, deceiving themselves; for emptiness will be their recompense.
text_cn: 别依恃枝桠已长大，应知这都是空虚；

text_en: It will be paid in full before their time, and their branch will not be green.
text_cn: 未到时日，已经凋谢，枝叶再不发绿。

text_en: They will shake off their unripe grape, like the vine, and cast off their blossoms, like the olive tree.
text_cn: 有如葡萄未熟即被打下，橄榄开花即被摇落，

text_en: For the company of the godless is barren, and fire consumes the tents of bribery.
text_cn: 因为恶人的家室必要绝嗣，火要烧尽受贿者的帐幕。

text_en: They conceive mischief and bring forth evil and their heart prepares deceit. ”
text_cn: 他们所怀的是邪恶，所生的是罪孽；心胸怀念的，无非是欺诈。
